entries.0129551859fe2fea: Operator of hotel and bridal facilities
entries.0ca88d0a81965706: A holding company with three consolidated subsidiaries that undertake interior construction for commercial facilities, hotels and others, and construction of audio and lighting equipment for facilities.
entries.345e2c70b81632b2: Operators of commercial facilities such as restaurants and retail stores
entries.40fa8bf2361cd500: Operator of office and exhibition facilities
entries.6753021daaa34d4d: This business is run by Nisshō Interlife Co., Ltd. The business covers planning, design, engineering, production and construction management for commercial facilities (restaurants and retail stores), hotels and bridal facilities, offices, and exhibitions, and also includes contract cleaning of building interiors and exteriors and maintenance of air-conditioning and other equipment. In June 2025, the company absorbed Facility Management Co., Ltd. through an absorption merger, and that company's business has been taken over as the FM Business Division. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥10,046 million.
entries.89f5f89c59d84249: Operators of lodging facilities such as hotels
entries.9f1f15e0a5325a7a: It plans, designs, builds and maintains facility audio-visual, stage lighting, flying rigging and council chamber systems, and introduces ＶＯＤ systems. It is a consolidated subsidiary (specified subsidiary) headquartered in Taito Ward, Tokyo.
entries.e11c7eecb8b203d7: Operators of facilities that introduce audio-visual and stage lighting equipment
entries.f76f593d706c8a6c: It consists of a specialist construction division, whose main business is undertaking substrate work and other construction contracts, and a commercial environment construction division, whose main business is acting as prime contractor. It is a consolidated subsidiary (specified subsidiary) headquartered in Arakawa Ward, Tokyo. It is also advancing the development and construction of energy-saving and environmental protection products, including “Atorasu Bōdo.”
entries.fc7cb78f2b346bf8: It provides end-to-end support for ＡＶＣ equipment, from system construction, sales, planning and design through production, construction and maintenance. It is a consolidated subsidiary headquartered in Ōta Ward, Tokyo, and became a subsidiary in November 2023.
entries.fdabf48a50638d06: System Engineering Co., Ltd. and Sanken System Co., Ltd. operate this business. It provides planning, design, construction and maintenance of facility staging and various equipment (audio-visual, stage lighting, flying rigging, council chamber systems, etc.), introduction of ＶＯＤ systems, and end-to-end support for ＡＶＣ (audio-visual & control) equipment, from system construction and sales through production, construction and maintenance. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥6,265 million.
